aboutMe.heading: About Me
aboutMe.paragraph: I'm a Full Stack Developer building scalable web applications and APIs. Currently freelancing at Rohimdev.com and working as Infrastructure & Application Engineer at Varnion Technology. I focus on clean architecture, RESTful APIs, and modern tooling—delivering 3-5 concurrent projects while improving velocity with AI-assisted development.
